headline: TSMC still evaluating ASML's 'High-NA' as Intel eyes future use
summary: AMSTERDAM (Reuters) -Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (2330.TW), the world's largest contract chipmaker, is still assessing when it will use ASML's cutting-edge high numerical aperture (NA) machines for its future process nodes, an executive said on Tuesday.
